RagShortTexts: The Miron River is the boundary river between Battania, the Northern Empire, and Sturgia

Variants.Content: The Miron River is the boundary river between Battania, the Northern Empire, and Sturgia. It has a small flow, but it cannot be crossed during the flood season. It freezes for two and a half months. It is an important natural moat for the northwestern defense line of the Northern Empire.
The Miron River is a river in Epiclothea
